name: Gibson Cove Campground
note: Clay County's second Lake Chatuge campground: a shoreline strip of gravel sites beside the county boat ramp, joined to the Recreation Park campground by a paved path across Chatuge Dam; some sites are let seasonally by an annual county lottery. TVA plans off-season drawdowns of the lake for dam safety work, possibly from fall 2027. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Clay County campground site campgrounds.claync.us (Gibson Cove page, 2027 rate sheet 'Clay County Rec. Park Sites and Gibson Cove', rules) + ReserveAmerica facility 1072250 site list read in a browser 2026-10-22: 40 Gibson Cove 'Standard Electric' sites (GC-001..040; 19 Lakefront loop, 21 Lakeview loop), back-in and pull-through, equipment length 28-50 ft; site GC-003 50-amp electric + water, gravel driveway, 14-day maximum -> real county drive-in RV campground, reservable by the night. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-22: ReserveAmerica per-site record GC-003 (loop 'Gibson Cove Campground Lakefront') 'Waterfront Site Y'; 19 of the 40 sites are in the Lakefront loop. Satellite: Esri 2024-04-29 and NC911 leaf-off ortho 2023-02-18 (0.15 m) at 35.0117,-83.7988 show gravel back-in pads in a strip between the access road and the Lake Chatuge shore, front-row pads ~20 m from the grass/high-water edge across open grass with scattered trees, no road or day-use strip between; the Feb image is at winter pool (~1,918 ft), so measured to the high-water edge, not the drawn-down waterline. Dam check: Chatuge Dam ~1.2 km NE, campground on the reservoir side; DEM 593 m at the pads vs ~587 m summer pool (~1,927 ft), above the lake not below.

fees.note: 2027 season, Rec Park and Gibson Cove: RV $30 a night lake view, $35 lakefront ($210 / $245 a week). Monthly ($440 / $500) is for seasonal lottery sites only.

fees_source: https://campgrounds.claync.us/_files/ugd/fe4bcd_866a752a1a9d44148808c1a1f1450fe4.pdf ('CLAY COUNTY REC. PARK CAMPING RATES 2027 CAMPING SEASON', 'Clay County Rec. Park Sites and Gibson Cove', 'RV Daily $30.00 [Lake View] $35.00 [Lake Front]'), read 2026-10-22
flags: Google Maps' pin (35.009869,-83.801147) sits on the boat-ramp road junction ~250 m SW of the sites; pinned to the front-row pads. ~390 m from entry 4324's pin, which is on the Rec Park peninsula to the SE.
Not on RV Life (no rating). ReserveAmerica sells it under the Rec Park facility 1072250, the same booking link as entry 4324.
TVA's Chatuge Dam safety work may draw the lake down in two off-seasons, as soon as fall 2027 (TVA EIS notice 2025; revised plan July 2025); worth a recheck before an off-season stay.
No sewer hookups: the county rules send all wastewater to the dump stations (as on 4324). Season Apr 1 - Oct 31 per the RA facility.
